title: Translation with the regional choice kept
description: The language preference is visible in every mode, along with the limits that apply.

blocks.text: A general language name can hide unfamiliar vocabulary and pronunciation. Setting it up again gets in the way of the conversation.

quote.text: This app has Portuguese from Brazil, but the Portuguese from Portugal is from Brazil. We don't use the same these words in Portugal. These words are spoken in Brazil only.

blocks.text: Let people choose the variant once and show it in the text and in the audio. Where a mode is not supported, explain exactly what will change.
A regional label does not guarantee that any given phrase is accurate. What is needed is the ability to correct the original and examples checked by native speakers.
